scene maineventthree1
: I swear to fucking god, if she doesn’t show up...
lines.zh: : 我操他妈的发誓，她要是敢不来……

lines.en: : Uhh...I’m no expert at shrines and stuff, but I’m pretty sure this is the last place you should be swearing to God.
lines.zh: : 呃……神社什么的我不太懂，但我敢肯定，这儿是最不该对着上帝发誓的地方。

lines.en: : And I’m pretty sure I’m going to set Ami’s half of the dorm on fire if she made both of us come all the way out here for nothing.
lines.zh: : 而且我敢肯定，如果她让我们俩白跑这一趟，我就把宿舍里 Ami 那一半给烧了。

lines.en: scene maineventthree2
: Maya, come on! I’m sure there’s a perfectly reasonable explanation for this! Maybe she’s just running late? Or her...phone died or something!
lines.zh: : Maya，别这样！我相信肯定有个非常合理的解释！也许她只是迟到呢？或者她……手机没电了之类的！

lines.en: : Ami would never just flat-out {i}ditch{/i} us, would she?
lines.zh: : Ami 绝不会就这么直接{i}放我们鸽子{/i}的，对吧？

lines.en: : We have been here...for a fucking {i}hour,{/i} Ayane. How much longer do we need to wait before you realize something is wrong?
lines.zh: : 我们在这儿……他妈等了一个{i}小时{/i}了，Ayane。还要等多久，你才会意识到出了事？

lines.en: scene maineventthree3
: How long am I supposed to wait?! Because the last time you had an issue with my...waiting tendencies, it was specifically {i}because{/i} I started freaking out!
lines.zh: : 我到底该等多久？！上次你嫌我……「等个没完」的时候，明明就是{i}因为{/i}我起了慌！

lines.en: : Now, you’re telling me I’m {i}supposed{/i} to be freaking out after telling me I’m not allowed to on the roof?! What do you want from me?!
lines.zh: : 现在你刚说完不许我在楼顶慌，转头又{i}要我{/i}慌起来？！你到底要我怎样？！

lines.en: : What I {i}want{/i} is for you to shut up. The phone is ringing.
lines.zh: : 我{i}要{/i}你闭嘴。电话在响。

lines.en: scene maineventthree4
: I never know what to say around you anymore...
lines.zh: : 我现在在你面前，都不知道该说什么了……

lines.en: : Then you’re better off not saying anything.
lines.zh: : 那你还是什么都别说比较好。

lines.en: {i}It sings in its sleep.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}它在睡梦里歌唱。{/i}

lines.en: {i}From its hole in the wall, a shadow emerges.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}从墙上的洞里，一个影子钻了出来。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Unconscious and covered in ash, its eyes remain closed as its body marches onward, disconnected from the orb that’s meant to move it.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}失去意识、浑身覆满灰烬，它双眼仍闭着，身体却径自向前行进，与那颗本该驱动它的眼球断开了连接。{/i}

lines.en: {i}It has one goal — to find another hole and lay itself down in a brand new resting place.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}它只有一个目标——找到另一个洞，在一处全新的安息之地躺下。{/i}

lines.en: {i}It doesn’t have to be a special one. {/i}
lines.zh: {i}不必是什么特别的洞。{/i}

lines.en: {i}All that matters is that it remains hidden.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}要紧的只有一件事：它得一直藏着。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Damp, dank, and several other D-adjectives combine forces to form a form of force that will form a fourth form, forced outforth before the fourth can form its course.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}潮湿、阴湿，外加好几个以 D 开头的形容词合流成一股「形之力」，这股力又去塑成第四个形态，在第四者来得及铺好自己的轨迹之前，就被强行推了出去。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Cicadas, spiders, birds, and any other creature you have assigned some level of significance to all conjoin as well into one ultimate being to end all other beings.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}蝉、蜘蛛、鸟，以及任何被你赋予了某种意义的生物，也都一并融合，聚成一个终结万物的终极存在。{/i}

lines.en: {i}If God or god exists, I think It or it needs to be everything.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}如果上帝或神存在，我想它必须是万物本身。{/i}

lines.en: {i}I don’t think we’re allowed to choose one or the other. In fact, I think the others as a whole are not so whole at all.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}我想我们没资格二选一。事实上，我认为那些「别的」凑在一起，一点也不成其为整体。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Think back to the holy trinity and question why it was ever deemed a trinity in the first place since the cross has {b}four{/b} points, not three.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}回想一下圣三位一体，问问它当初凭什么被定为「三」——毕竟十字架有{b}四个{/b}点，不是三个。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Could they not form fourth for some added posterity in that grand fairy-tale of theirs?{/i}
lines.zh: {i}在他们那部宏大的童话里，难道就凑不出第四个，好显得更体面些吗？{/i}

lines.en: {i}Because while you may be taught that the middle part is one-{/i}
lines.zh: {i}因为虽说他们教你「中间那部分是合一的」——{/i}

lines.en: {i}And while you may be taught that the top is king-{/i}
lines.zh: {i}虽说他们教你「顶上那位是王」——{/i}

lines.en: {i}And while you may be taught to ignore the bottom-{/i}
lines.zh: {i}虽说他们教你别去看底下——{/i}

lines.en: {i}You’re smart enough to count to the things you see before you.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}你也够聪明，能数清眼前这些东西。{/i}

lines.en: {i}And you know you’re being lied to.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}而你知道，有人在对你撒谎。{/i}

lines.en: {i}But who’s the one that’s lying now that none of that really matters?{/i}
lines.zh: {i}可既然那些都不重要了，那么此刻撒谎的又是谁？{/i}

lines.en: {i}Is it Ami? Your lovable niece?{/i}
lines.zh: {i}是 Ami 吗？你那讨人喜欢的侄女？{/i}

lines.en: {i}Maya? Your former lover? {/i}
lines.zh: {i}Maya？你的旧情人？{/i}

lines.en: {i}Ayane? The deeply unfortunate third wheel that wasn’t replaced at the same time the others were?{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Ayane？那个倒霉透顶的电灯泡，别人都被换掉了，偏偏她没被一起换掉？{/i}

lines.en: {i}Is EVERYONE lying to you?{/i}
lines.zh: {i}是不是所有人都在骗你？{/i}

lines.en: {i}Is there anyone you can trust at all?{/i}
lines.zh: {i}还有没有一个人是你能信任的？{/i}

lines.en: {i}I think there is.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}我想是有的。{/i}

lines.en: {i}But telling you WHO would be against the rules.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}但告诉你是「谁」，是违反规则的。{/i}

lines.en: {i}So I’ll sit and watch, my eyes are glued — just this time with a better view;{/i}
lines.zh: {i}所以我只会坐下来看着，目光黏在那里——只是这一次，视野更好；{/i}

lines.en: {i}I’ll hold your hand and sleep with you — just not the way you want me to.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}我会握着你的手陪你睡——只是不是你想要的那种方式。{/i}

lines.en: {i}It’s not that I don’t care, I do — this is different and you know it’s true.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}不是我不在乎，我在乎——这一次不一样，你自己也明白这是真的。{/i}

lines.en: {i}And if you don’t, pick up my clues — they’re everywhere and dressed in blue!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}如果你不信，去捡我留给你的线索吧——它们无处不在，还穿着一身蓝！{/i}

lines.en: {i}They’re all for you, they’re all for you, they’re all for you, they’re all for you-{/i}
lines.zh: {i}它们都是给你的，它们都是给你的，它们都是给你的，它们都是给你的——{/i}

lines.en: {i}They’re all for you! They’re all for you they’re all for you! tfdheyre All for yopu! UTHeyre Alsl fo r you! Theyre all for youy!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}它们都是给你的！它们都是给你的它们都是给你的！它们——都——是——给——你——的！它们全都给你！它们都是给你的！{/i}

lines.en: {i}{b}{size=+30}THEY’RE ALL FOR YOU PLEASE TRUST ME{/b}{/size}{/i}
lines.zh: {i}{b}{size=+30}它们全都是给你的，求你相信我{/size}{/b}{/i}

lines.en: scene maineventthree5
: Come the fuck on! Where are you?!
lines.zh: : 操，来啊！你到底在哪儿？！

lines.en: scene maineventthree6
: What, {i}now{/i} you don’t have anything to say all of a sudden?
lines.zh: : 怎么，{i}突然{/i}就没话说了？

lines.en: : Huh? No, I just...thought I...
lines.zh: : 啊？不是，我只是……以为我……

lines.en: scene maineventthree7
: Wait, why are you taking your anger out on {i}me?!{/i} I’m not the one who ditched you! I walked here {i}with{/i} you!
lines.zh: : 等等，你干嘛拿{i}我{/i}撒气？！放你鸽子的又不是我！我是{i}陪你{/i}一路走过来的！

lines.en: : I don’t have anyone else to take it out on! And we probably wouldn’t even be {i}in{/i} this mess if it weren’t for you!
lines.zh: : 我没有别人可以撒气！而且要不是因为你，我们大概根本不会{i}落到这步田地{/i}！

lines.en: : How is any of this my fault?! I was just trying to watch a movie when you barged in and started yelling stuff about Ami!
lines.zh: : 这怎么就怪我了？！我本来好好在看电影，你冲进来就开始大吼大叫地说 Ami 的事！

lines.en: : I don’t know! But it’s definitely not mine! And...
lines.zh: : 我不知道！但绝对不怪我！而且……

lines.en: scene maineventthree8
: And you probably said something about the resets to her even though I told you not to.
lines.zh: : 而且你大概还是跟她提了「重置」的事，尽管我跟你说了别提。

lines.en: : Did you, Ayane?
lines.zh: : 你有吗，Ayane？

lines.en: : Did you tell her something?
lines.zh: : 你跟她说了什么？

lines.en: scene clearnightsky
: I guess...{i}maybe?{/i}
lines.zh: : 大概……{i}有吧{/i}？

lines.en: : I might have made, like...a joke or something. But it’s not like I’ve actually tried {i}talking{/i} to her about it...
lines.zh: : 我说不定……开了个……之类的玩笑。但我其实从没真的试着跟她{i}聊{/i}过那件事……

lines.en: : I know you and me don’t always see eye to eye about this stuff but I still take everything you say seriously.
lines.zh: : 我知道你跟我在这类事上总是谈不拢，但我还是把你说的话都当真。

lines.en: : Have you tried calling Sensei instead? He-
lines.zh: : 你没试着打给 Sensei 吗？他——

lines.en: : It’s going straight to voicemail. His phone is probably dead. Ami’s is still ringing, though.
lines.zh: : 直接转语音信箱了。他手机大概是没电了。不过 Ami 的还在响。

lines.en: : What does...what would me talking to her about all that time stuff even do, though? Why would she stop hanging out with us over that?
lines.zh: : 可是……我跟她聊那些时间的事又能有什么用呢？她为什么要因为这个就不跟我们来往了？

lines.en: : It’s a long story.
lines.zh: : 说来话长。

lines.en: : Then fucking tell me, Maya! What good does it do to be so fucking cryptic about everything?!
lines.zh: : 那他妈就说啊，Maya！什么都藏着掖着到底有什么好处？！

lines.en: scene maineventthree9

: I’m not like this because I {i}want{/i} to be! I’m like this because I’ve learned time and fucking time again that not being careful about the things I say can cause everything to spiral out of control!
lines.zh: : 我这样子不是因为我{i}想{/i}！我这样子是因为我他妈一次又一次地学到：说话不小心，就能让一切失控打转！

lines.en: : I’m sure it must be fan-fucking-tastic living in an infinite school-year and {i}not{/i} having to deal with countless memories of personally destroying everything, but I can’t do that!
lines.zh: : 活在无限循环的一个学年里，{i}不用{/i}去面对那些由我亲手毁掉一切的无数段记忆，想必他妈爽翻天了——但我做不到！

lines.en: scene maineventthree10
: Okay. Yeah. I get that. And I’m not trying to make light of what you’ve been through. I just don’t understand what any of this has to do with Ami.
lines.zh: : 好。是。我懂。我也不是要拿你的经历不当回事。我只是不明白这些跟 Ami 有什么关系。

lines.en: : Why is she bailing on us? Why is she inviting us to the shrine in the first place? Why does she apparently get mad whenever she learns about the timeloops?
lines.zh: : 她为什么放我们鸽子？她为什么一开始要约我们到神社来？为什么她一听说时间循环的事就明显发火？

lines.en: : {i}How{/i} can she learn about them if she’s supposed to interrupt us whenever they’re brought up? {i}There are a million things I don’t know because you’re keeping everything to yourself.
lines.zh: : 如果她本来就该在我们提起时打断我们，那她又是{i}怎么{/i}听说的？{i}有上百万件事我不知道，因为你什么都憋在自己心里。{/i}

lines.en: : And I get that you’re, like, not good at talking about stuff or whatever, but you’ve never tried talking to {i}me.{/i} And {i}I’m{/i} not Sensei. I can probably, like, understand your problems to some extent.
lines.zh: : 我知道你……嗯，不擅长聊这些之类的，可你从来没试着跟{i}我{/i}聊过。{i}我{/i}又不是 Sensei。我大概多少能理解你的难处。

lines.en: : Why? Because you can {i}relate{/i} to me?
lines.zh: : 为什么？因为你能跟我{i}共情{/i}？

lines.en: : Why are you saying that like it’s a bad thing?
lines.zh: : 你干嘛说得好像这是什么坏事？

lines.en: scene maineventthree11
: Probably because you’ve been fucking {i}flaunting{/i} how “relatable” you are this entire fucking time!
lines.zh: : 大概是因为你这他妈从头到尾都在{i}炫耀{/i}自己多「让人有共鸣」！

lines.en: : What?...
: Do you have any idea how fucking {i}infuriating{/i} it is hearing about all of the shit {i}you{/i} get to do with Sensei when I can’t even fucking {i}touch{/i} him?!
lines.zh: : 你知不知道，听着{i}你{/i}讲那些你能跟 Sensei 一起做的事，而我连{i}碰{/i}都不能碰他，是有多他妈让人{i}火大{/i}？！

lines.en: : Do you think it’s {i}funny?!{/i} Do you think I {i}like{/i} that?! Because I fucking hate it, Ayane! I hate it, I hate it, I hate it, I hate it!
lines.zh: : 你觉得很{i}有意思{/i}吗？！你觉得我{i}乐意{/i}吗？！因为我他妈恨透了，Ayane！我恨，我恨，我恨，我恨！

lines.en: scene maineventthree12

: I hate it I hate it I hate it I hate it I hate it I hate it I hate it I hate it I hate it I hate it I hate it I hate it I hate it I hate it I hate it I hate it I hate it I hate it I hate it I hate it I hate it I hate it I hate it I hate it I hate it I hate it I hate it
lines.zh: : 我恨，我恨，我恨，我恨，我恨，我恨，我恨，我恨，我恨，我恨，我恨，我恨，我恨，我恨，我恨，我恨，我恨，我恨，我恨，我恨，我恨，我恨，我恨，我恨，我恨，我恨，我恨，我恨，我恨

lines.en: : Maya...I didn’t...
lines.zh: : Maya……我没有……

lines.en: : I didn’t really...uhh...
lines.zh: : 我真的没有……呃……

lines.en: scene maineventthree13
: I guess I...didn’t really understand what you were...
lines.zh: : 我大概是……没真正听懂你当时……

lines.en: : Yeah. Because I’m fucking {i}cryptic{/i} or whatever. But, like I said, I’m not like that because I {i}want{/i} to be. I just don’t know what I can and can’t do and...
lines.zh: : 是啊。因为我太他妈喜欢{i}打哑谜{/i}了。可就像我说过的，我这样不是因为我{i}想{/i}。我只是不知道什么能说、什么不能说，而且……

lines.en: : And I feel like certain aspects of this world might make you even more afraid of it than you already are.
lines.zh: : 而且我觉得这个世界的某些面向，可能会让你比现在更害怕它。

lines.en: scene maineventthree14
: What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : You heard me. Don’t make me say it again.
lines.zh: : 你听见了。别让我再说一遍。

lines.en: : Do you mean you were...do you mean it was never a trust thing at all? You just didn’t want to make things more...complicated than they already were? For my sake?
lines.zh: : 你是说你……你是说这根本不是信任不信任的问题？你只是不想让事情变得比现在更……复杂？是为了我？

lines.en: : My wording was better.
lines.zh: : 我的措辞比较好听。

lines.en: scene maineventthree15
: You’d think after a bajillion school years there would have been at least {i}one{/i} Ayane that made you realize I can take a punch or two.
lines.zh: : 明明经过了好几十亿个学年，你总该遇到过{i}一个{/i} Ayane，能让你意识到我还是挨得起一两拳的。

lines.en: : This is more than just a punch, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 这可不止是一拳，Ayane。

lines.en: scene maineventthree16
: This is {i}bad.{/i}
lines.zh: : 这很{i}糟糕{/i}。

lines.en: : Ami getting too involved in this isn’t something as trivial as just risking our friendship or...tightening Sensei’s leash.
lines.zh: : Ami 卷进这件事太深，可不是什么「赌上我们的友情」或者「把 Sensei 的绳子勒紧点」这种小事。

lines.en: : It is {i}dangerous.{/i}
lines.zh: : 这是{i}危险{/i}的。

lines.en: : As in...she could somehow put...the reset at risk? Has she gotten in the way before or something?
lines.zh: : 就是说……她有可能让……重置本身出问题？她以前碍过事吗，还是怎么的？

lines.en: scene maineventthree17
: Yes.
: But it’s far more complicated than just that.
lines.zh: : 但远不止这么简单。

lines.en: : Can you tell me how? Or are you just going to be all cryptic again?
lines.zh: : 你能告诉我怎么个复杂法吗？还是你又要开始打哑谜了？

lines.en: scene maineventthree18
: I’m going to do my best to not be emotional...and deliver this message in a way more like my normal self.
lines.zh: : 我会尽量不带情绪……用更像平时的我的方式，把这件事说出来。

lines.en: : As long as it’s delivered...
lines.zh: : 只要能说出口就行……

lines.en: : If it’s this important, I need to know.
lines.zh: : 既然这么重要，我就得知道。

lines.en: : Then...
lines.zh: : 那么……

lines.en: scene clearnightsky
: Please listen closely.
lines.zh: : 请听仔细。

lines.en: : Because while I don’t understand the reason {i}why{/i} the resets seem to trigger her-
lines.zh: : 因为虽然我不明白{i}为什么{/i}重置似乎会触发她——

lines.en: : I’ve seen what happens when they do.
lines.zh: : 但我见过触发之后会发生什么。

lines.en: : I have watched you...the others...and even Sensei suffer at her broken hands because she will stop at {i}nothing{/i} to protect her world.
lines.zh: : 我目睹过你……其他人……甚至 Sensei，在她那双残破的手底下受苦，因为她为了保护自己的世界，{i}什么都{/i}做得出来。

lines.en: : What...do you mean by-
lines.zh: : 你……这是什么意思——

lines.en: : I mean that the only thing preventing her from becoming violent is the illusion that she lives the perfect life.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，唯一能拦住她不走向暴力的东西，是「她过着完美人生」这个幻象。

lines.en: : That her uncle does not just {i}love{/i} her, but is {i}in{/i} love with her.
lines.zh: : 是「她的舅舅不只是{i}爱{/i}她，而是{i}爱上了{/i}她」这个幻象。

lines.en: : That her friends understand and acknowledge her feelings...and always act in {i}her{/i} best interests.
lines.zh: : 是「她的朋友理解并承认她的感情……并且永远为{i}她{/i}的最佳利益行事」这个幻象。

lines.en: : And that nothing or no one gets in the way.
lines.zh: : 以及「没有任何东西、任何人挡她的路」这个幻象。

lines.en: : And if...someone {i}does?{/i}
lines.zh: : 那如果……有人{i}挡了{/i}呢？

lines.en: scene maineventthree19
: She’ll get rid of them.
lines.zh: : 她会把他们除掉。

lines.en: : She’ll...what?
lines.zh: : 她会……什么？

lines.en: : Before all of the transfers...
lines.zh: : 在所有转学生到来之前……

lines.en: : There was not a {i}single{/i} girl in our class...
lines.zh: : 我们班上没有{i}一个{/i}女生……

lines.en: : That I had not seen {i}butchered...{/i}
lines.zh: : 是我不曾见过被{i}屠戮{/i}的……

lines.en: : Or {i}bound...{/i}
lines.zh: : 或被{i}捆绑{/i}的……

lines.en: : Or {i}beaten...{/i}
lines.zh: : 或被{i}殴打{/i}的……

lines.en: : Or {i}broken...{/i}
lines.zh: : 或被{i}折断{/i}的……

lines.en: : {i}Abused...{/i}
: {i}Humiliated...{/i}
: {i}Tortured..{/i}.
: {i}Maimed...{/i}
: {i}Poisoned...{/i}
: {i}Sodomized...{/i}
: {i}Starved...{/i}
: You can’t be...no. No way. This is {i}Ami{/i} we’re talking about. Like, yeah! She’s obsessed with Sensei on an...abnormal and dangerous level...but she’d never do anything like that to {i}us!{/i}
lines.zh: : 你不可能……不。不可能。我们说的是 {i}Ami{/i} 啊。对，行！她对 Sensei 的执念确实……不正常而且危险……但她绝不会对{i}我们{/i}做那种事！

lines.en: : We’re her friends! We’re-
lines.zh: : 我们是她的朋友啊！我们是——

lines.en: : We’re nothing to her.
lines.zh: : 我们对她什么都不是。

lines.en: : We’re just part of the illusion.
lines.zh: : 我们只是幻象的一部分。

lines.en: : She’ll play into it...and treat us well if we treat {i}her{/i} well...
lines.zh: : 她会顺着这个幻象演下去……我们待{i}她{/i}好，她就待我们好……

lines.en: : But the Ami I'm talking about will never see us as anything more than disposable sacks of flesh.
lines.zh: : 但我现在说的这个 Ami，永远不会把我们看成比「可以随手丢弃的一袋肉」更多的东西。

lines.en: : Then...then all those things you say about her being cute! And how you love her! All of that’s been fake?! This entire time?!
lines.zh: : 那……那你说的那些她可爱的话！还有你有多爱她！那些全是假的？！从头到尾？！

lines.en: : Maya!
lines.zh: : Maya！

lines.en: : Hahah...that's the hilarious part...
lines.zh: : 哈哈……这恰恰是最可笑的地方……

lines.en: : None of it’s been fake at all...
lines.zh: : 那些一点都不是假的……

lines.en: : I {i}do{/i} love her.
lines.zh: : 我是{i}真的{/i}爱她。

lines.en: : I {i}do{/i} think she’s the cutest girl I know.
lines.zh: : 我是{i}真的{/i}觉得她是我认识的最可爱的女孩。

lines.en: : {i}But how can I not when she’s always been right there?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}可她一直就在我眼前，我怎么能不爱她？{/i}

lines.en: : How can I let the bad memories taint the brighter ones when they’ve only come as the result of things {i}I{/i} have done wrong?!
lines.zh: : 那些坏的记忆明明全都源于{i}我自己{/i}做错的事，我又怎么能让它去染黑那些更明亮的记忆？！

lines.en: : The {i}real{/i} Ami isn’t like that! The {i}real{/i} Ami wouldn’t hurt us! Only the one we {i}create{/i} would!
lines.zh: : {i}真正{/i}的 Ami 不是那样的！{i}真正{/i}的 Ami 不会伤害我们！只有我们{i}制造{/i}出来的那个才会！

lines.en: : Which is exactly why she can never know where we are...or {i}when{/i} we are.
lines.zh: : 所以她才永远不能知道我们在哪儿……或者我们在{i}什么时候{/i}。

lines.en: : Because {i}that’s{/i} what changes her. {i}That’s{/i} what plants the seed...
lines.zh: : 因为{i}那{/i}正是改变她的东西。{i}那{/i}正是埋下种子的东西……

lines.en: : And everything that comes after just helps it grow...
lines.zh: : 而之后发生的一切，只是在帮它长大……

lines.en: I love my niece.
lines.zh: 我爱我的侄女。

lines.en: She’s the greatest niece in the whole wide world.
lines.zh: 她是全世界最棒的侄女。

lines.en: Sometimes, when I fall asleep, her face reappears inside of my dreams.
lines.zh: 有时候我睡着，她的脸会重新出现在我的梦里。

lines.en: When I look in the mirror, I see her behind me- even when she isn’t there.
lines.zh: 我照镜子时，会看见她在我身后——哪怕她根本不在。

lines.en: In every gust of wind, I hear her name.
lines.zh: 每一阵风里，我都听见她的名字。

lines.en: In every song, I hear the same.
lines.zh: 每一首歌里，我也听见同样的名字。

lines.en: Every time I encounter the color red, I compare it to the hue of her eyes.
lines.zh: 每次遇到红色，我都会拿来跟她眼睛的颜色比一比。

lines.en: I’ve memorized them.
lines.zh: 我早把它们背下来了。

lines.en: It was easy.
lines.zh: 很容易。

lines.en: They’re the same as her mother’s.
lines.zh: 因为它们和她母亲的是一个颜色。

lines.en: : Sensei...
lines.zh: : Sensei……

lines.en: : Yeah?...
: Tell me you love me again.
lines.zh: : 再说一遍你爱我。

lines.en: : I love you...
lines.zh: : 我爱你……

lines.en: : Only me?
lines.zh: : 只爱我？

lines.en: : Only you...
lines.zh: : 只爱你……

lines.en: : You promise?
lines.zh: : 你保证？

lines.en: : I promise...
lines.zh: : 我保证……

lines.en: : Can I sleep in your bed tonight?
lines.zh: : 今晚我能睡你床上吗？

lines.en: : Of course...
lines.zh: : 当然……

lines.en: : And tomorrow? And the day after?
lines.zh: : 明天呢？后天呢？

lines.en: : You can do whatever you want...
lines.zh: : 你想怎样都行……

lines.en: : You promise?
lines.zh: : 你保证？

lines.en: : I promise...
lines.zh: : 我保证……

lines.en: : Sensei...
lines.zh: : Sensei……

lines.en: : Yeah?...
: Tell me you love me again.
lines.zh: : 再说一遍你爱我。

lines.en: scene black
I love my niece.
lines.zh: 我爱我的侄女。

lines.en: if amifingered == False:
But sometimes I worry that I don’t love her enough.
lines.zh: 但有时候我又担心，我给她的爱还不够。

lines.en: $ amispecial50mainp1 = True
$ ami_love += 1
jump amispecial50mainp2
